metadata.title: That 1 kill where even Valorant was like ‘Wait, how’d that happen?’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just steal a kill with zero effort?
My aim was napping but the game said ‘surprise!’
Click if your best plays feel like accidents too.
Valorant logic strikes again!

Hit play if your aim ghosts you but kills still happen!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
